name: Combine harvester
summary: Combine harvester in side view with a cutting header, spinning reel, cab and grain tank; for farm and harvest scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the tyres stand on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 940 px wide and 780 px tall at s = 1; about 0.6 next to a person

params.name: color2
params.note: pipe, reel, ladder and cutter bar colour

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels and reel turn and the body rocks (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)
